gen-gf-gveret-levin-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta spreads wide and tall, each stroke a cut ribbon. Gveret Levin sits over it like a friendly scrawl, its rope-thick curves loosening the whole arrangement.
gen-gf-gveret-levin-gf-montserrat-altern: Montserrat Alternates reads crisp and contemporary, its round letters crowding up toward the capital line. And Gveret Levin, hand-drawn and friendly, gives it a looser voice, so a slightly smaller size for the sans-serif text feels right.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-archivo: Archivo stands tall and commanding, its curves opening outward instead of curling in. Archivo gives the hand-drawn Hachi Maru Pop something sturdy to lean on, so paragraphs flow easily without losing that relaxed mood.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-bespoke-serif: Stretched-out, hand-drawn letter spacing gives Hachi Maru Pop its relaxed charm, with no hairlines or shadows anywhere in its pen line. Bespoke Serif follows with dignified, pen-steady strokes that feel made for short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-epilogue: Loose, curvy and tall. Hachi Maru Pop brings its hand-drawn, widely spaced warmth up top, while Epilogue keeps a wire-thin monoline skeleton below, stubby ascenders and all, making the sans feel crisp beside it.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-erode: Erode brings a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight to the serif text. Hachi Maru Pop is the friendly handwriting; Erode is the dignified voice.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-fira-sans: Hachi Maru Pop stretches its hand-drawn letters out wide, and its e opens clearly to the right. Yet Fira Sans, with its large x-height and broad s curves, keeps a longer read feeling clean and sturdy.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-public-sans: Public Sans is hefty in the lowercase, with broad open counters. Under the hand-drawn Hachi Maru Pop, a slightly modest size for the plain sans text would keep the heading's pen line in front.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-supreme: Crisp is the word for Supreme, a heavy-looking band of text with letters held open. Hachi Maru Pop does relaxed, hand-drawn charm best, while Supreme does steady, sharp-edged clarity in the sans text.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-general-sans: Relaxed and hand-drawn, Hachi Maru Pop stretches its spacing out, then lets General Sans take over with an x-height that fills the line. Pressure stays steady and every bend runs smooth, so a plain sans text moves along easily.
